description: All trajectories are deterministic synthetic fixtures; the benchmark does not establish real-world memory semantics.
Each family has one stored reference, so within-family outcome diversity and episode density are not evaluated.
Similarity scores are weighted v0.7 signature heuristics, not calibrated probabilities or semantic equivalence.
One of twelve queries ranked a different system family first: the parameter-shifted Kuramoto query was ranked as Lorenz.
At least one expected-family score is separated from the best alternative by less than 0.05 or is ranked below it.
